text: 为推动车企、经销商进一步加强自律，不断规范汽车行业网上信息传播秩序，上海市委网信办会同市经信委、市商务委、市市场监管局、市公安局网安总队，指导上海市汽车销售行业协会、上海市汽车零部件行业协会，制定《上海市汽车行业营销行为与网络信息传播合规公约》。
text_en: To encourage automakers and dealers to further strengthen self-discipline and continuously standardize online information dissemination order in the automotive industry, the Shanghai Cyberspace Administration, together with the Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization, the Municipal Commission of Commerce, the Municipal Market Supervision Administration, and the Municipal Public Security Bureau's Network Security Corps, guided the Shanghai Automobile Sales Industry Association and the Shanghai Auto Parts Industry Association to formulate the 'Shanghai Automotive Industry Marketing Behavior and Network Information Dissemination Compliance Convention'.
